value.definition: the labelled texts a prompt is judged by
every puzzle a set has, one to a line

invariants.statement: A puzzle is a row here rather than a page of its own.
A row nobody has answered has no answer.
A row is taken from the set's source rather than composed here.
A row is keyed on the id its source gives the puzzle.

value.definition: every pull a sync has made, one to a line

invariants.statement: A run names no source.
A run sits beside the sync that run was a pull of.
A run reporting no counts failed before reaching anything to count.

value.definition: the movements of money a month covers, one to a line

invariants.statement: A transaction sits beside the month its day falls in rather than in a file of its own.
Ten thousand transactions arrive from a poller and nobody writes a transaction by hand.
An entry states nothing that entry has no value for.
A value an entry does not state is false or empty.
Entries sit in the order of the day those entries fell on and then of their Monarch id.
A split transaction leaves the list Monarch serves and its parts are there in its place.
A split transaction stays alive and reachable by its own id.
An entry's id is carried across a resync rather than minted again.

value.definition: something pushed at a person rather than waiting for them to look

invariants.statement: A notification pushed at a person sits in that person's feed rather than in a page of its own.
Notifications sit in the order those notifications were pushed.
The oldest notification sits first.
No setting says which notifications reach a person.
The filters on the unread view are the settings.
A notification with no instant that notification was read at is unread.
Every notification deep-links to itself.

value.definition: every track a person has heard, one to a line

invariants.statement: Every heard track names a Spotify track id.
No two heard tracks on one page name the same Spotify track id.
A heard track is written the first time the track is heard.

value.definition: every round of a to-do finished on a day, one to a line
every measurement Alan's phone took whose stretch began on a day, one to a line
every play Alan finished on a day, one to a line

invariants.statement: A play key names a single listen.
An ESO day without listening carries no listens file.
A listen names no persona.

value.definition: every stretch of time a day was spent in, one to a line

invariants.statement: A question about a stretch is identified by a mark minted when the row is written.
A question about a stretch is never identified by that stretch's title.
A stretch with no end is the stretch running now.
A stretch is a row here rather than a page a query may ask of.
A calculation is handed the rows this file has in place of the extension the page has.
A row is spelled as the file spells the row.

value.definition: every message a mailbox has been through and what was settled, one to a line

invariants.statement: A message is written here once the decision about that message is settled.
A second pass over the same mailbox skips a message already written here.
A processed message sits beside the mailbox that message was read from.
A processed message sits in no row of its own.
An entry is slugged by the id Gmail gives the message.

value.definition: every place a chapter dates something, one place to a line

invariants.statement: An anchor is one place in one chapter rather than a date the chapter has.
An anchor has the words that date the anchor.
An anchor naming nobody who claimed that anchor is an anchor the story itself tells.
Every chapter a world's chronology rests on has its anchors here.

value.definition: every place a story names a mechanic, one place to a line

invariants.statement: A reference is one place in one chapter rather than a count of places.
The wording is the text's own.
The mechanic's title need not match the wording.
A reference naming no holder is a reference the text attributed to no character.
A quote is carried so a reading can be checked against the text that quote came from.

value.definition: how each name a world's text uses is read as a character, one name to a line

invariants.statement: A reading names its character only where the reading's kind is `character`.

value.definition: how each name a world's text uses is read as a mechanic, one name to a line

invariants.statement: A reading names its mechanic unless the reading's kind is `none` or `unsure`.

value.definition: what must have before a companion casts a skill, one test to a line

invariants.statement: A test names which kind of test the test is.
Which fields a test carries beyond its kind follows from that kind.
A test gathering several tests has each gathered test.
A skill tested by nothing states no test rather than an empty list.

value.definition: what casting a companion's skill does, one effect to a line

invariants.statement: An effect names the kind of thing casting a skill does.
Which fields an effect carries beyond its kind follows from that kind.
An effect that delays or repeats has an inner effect.
A skill with no effect states no effect rather than an empty list.

value.definition: what a companion's own passive moves, one metric to a line
what a set gives at each piece count, one count to a line
the icon each piece of a set is shown with, one piece to a line
the achievements a heading holds, one achievement to a line

invariants.statement: An achievement here is an achievement the game files under the heading with the line.
The lines run in ascending order of the achievement id.

value.definition: the antiquities a category has, one antiquity to a line

invariants.statement: An antiquity here is an antiquity a player digs up and reads lore from.

value.definition: the points of interest Cadwell names in a level, one point to a line

invariants.statement: A stop here is one point of interest Cadwell sends a player to.

value.definition: the collectibles a category holds, one collectible to a line

invariants.statement: A collectible here is filed by the game under the category with the file.

value.definition: the books a lore collection holds, one book to a line

invariants.statement: A book here is a book a player finds in the world and reads into a collection.

value.definition: the recipes a list covers, one recipe to a line

invariants.statement: A recipe here is a recipe a player learns from an item the game names.
The recipes of one list are kept in the order the game hands the recipes over.

value.definition: the traits a research line covers, one trait to a line

invariants.statement: A trait here is a trait a player researches on the item a line names.

value.definition: the cards a patron hands out, one card to a line

invariants.statement: A card here is a card a patron lets a player upgrade.

value.definition: the affix scripts a grimoire takes, one to a line
the signature scripts a grimoire takes, one to a line
the achievements a scribing source's tiers are counted by, one to a line
the points of interest a zone holds, one place to a line

invariants.statement: A place here has the label of the kind of point of interest the place is.

value.definition: the activities a zone is completed by, one activity to a line

invariants.statement: An activity here has the label of the completion type the activity falls under.

value.definition: the quests a zone holds, one quest to a line

invariants.statement: A quest here is a quest the game counts against the zone that quest is given in.

value.definition: what a thing does, one effect to a line

invariants.statement: An effect moves a metric or puts a buff on the character or companion with the effect.
An effect stating no metric states a buff or a debuff.
Which further fields an effect states is settled by the effect type.

value.definition: what a thing is worth at each grade, one grade to a line
what firing a skill does, one effect to a line
every item a sweep read out of the game, one item to a line
every quest a sweep read out of the game, one quest to a line
how many slots each bag of each holder has, one bag to a line

invariants.statement: One line is one bag of one holder.
A holder with no bag of a kind has no line for that kind.

value.definition: how far each character has come in each craft, one craft to a line

invariants.statement: One line is one craft of one character.
A craft a character has not opened still has a line.

value.definition: how much of each currency is held, one purse to a line

invariants.statement: One line is one currency held under one scope.
A currency held across the whole account names no character.
A currency held by one character names when that character was last read.

value.definition: when each timed activity comes round again, one activity to a line

invariants.statement: One line is one cooldown a reading found.
A cooldown names when that cooldown comes round again rather than how long is left.

value.definition: what furnishing sits in each home and what it is worth, one furnishing to a line

invariants.statement: One line is one furnishing placed in one home.
A price field is absent where the price source priced nothing.
A furnishing is reached by an item link or by a collectible link.

value.definition: what each bag holder was named and when it was last read, one holder to a line

invariants.statement: One line is one bag holder a reading found.
When a holder was last read is the holder's own moment rather than the reading's.

value.definition: what a reading found in every slot, one slot to a line

invariants.statement: One line is one slot with one item.
A slot with nothing has no line.
Which further fields a line states is settled by the sort of item.
A price field is absent where the price source priced nothing.

value.definition: what an account was worth, one reading to a line
where a rule puts an item, one leg to a line

invariants.statement: The order the legs are written in is the order the legs are tried.
An item goes to the first leg that will take that item.
A leg taking every item is the last leg worth writing.
A rule stating a chain states where the chain ends.

value.definition: what an item must satisfy for a rule to act, one test to a line

invariants.statement: A rule stating no condition matches every item of its category.
A field names a temper-condition-field page with the key the field tests.
The key a rule engine reads is held by that page rather than written here.
A field naming a comparison has the key of a temper comparison op.
